The animal known for its long neck is the giraffe.

Here is the adjusted email, rewritten to be more professional, constructive, and aligned with standard HR best practices while maintaining the necessary seriousness:

Subject: Important Discussion Regarding Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

We are writing to address some recent concerns regarding your workplace behavior. Specifically, we have received feedback indicating that certain actions have not aligned with our company’s core values and professional standards.

Our goal is to ensure a respectful and productive environment for everyone. We value your contributions to the team and believe that with some immediate adjustments, you can get back on track. We would like to schedule a meeting with you to discuss these matters in detail, clarify expectations, and support you in making the necessary improvements.

Please let us know your availability for a brief meeting later this week. We are committed to helping you succeed and look forward to resolving this matter constructively.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
